'''''Queen's Shadow''''' is a [[canon]] young-adult novel written by [[E. K. Johnston]]. It was published by [[Disney–Lucasfilm Press]] on [[March 5]], [[2019]]. Set four [[Standard year|years]] after the events of [[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''The Phantom Menace'']], ''Queen's Shadow'' focuses on [[Padmé Amidala]] and her transition from [[Monarch of Naboo|queen]] to [[senator]].
